verdicts.reason: The two candidates look pixel-identical. Both shrink the plan cards into tiny chips. The MONTHLY/YEARLY/FAMILY labels and per-month captions can't be read, and the cards are reordered to 6, 80, 48, so the highlighted yearly plan loses its central spot. The subhead and legal fine print are squeezed into a cramped right-edge column that touches the canvas edge, with fine print almost as large as the subhead.
